coverageNotes: Focused local decision coverage. Full implementation, scale, authorization and provider quality remain outside this bank; see author records. This local revision incorporates the exact-input presentation pilot q-shared-cap; other questions are preserved.

questions.concept: A default retry policy does not enable Workpool action retries
questions.question: How many action attempts and completion callbacks occur for this job?

options.text: Three attempts; three callbacks with failed results.
options.rationale: The policy is not enabled. Even when enabled, intermediate failed attempts do not each produce the final completion callback.

options.text: Three attempts; one callback with a failed result.
options.rationale: This is the control with retryActionsByDefault: true. Defining the default policy alone does not activate it.

options.text: Four attempts; one callback with a failed result.
options.rationale: maxAttempts counts total attempts, not extra retries, and this default policy is not enabled.

options.text: One attempt; one callback with a failed result.
options.rationale: Workpool defaults retryActionsByDefault to false. The supplied retry behavior is used only if retries are enabled.

questions.question: Which change caps total concurrent requests at five while letting either workload use all five slots when the other is idle?

options.text: Move both pool clients into one TypeScript module; keep the separate mounts and limits of five.
options.rationale: Module location does not merge the state of separately mounted component instances. The representative single-module implementation still exceeds five combined requests.

options.text: Enqueue both workloads through one mounted pool with a limit of five.
options.rationale: Both workloads then use the same five execution slots. Either workload can use all five while the other is idle.

options.text: Keep the separate mounts; lower each pool limit to two.
options.rationale: The combined cap is at most four, but one workload cannot use five slots while the other is idle.

options.text: Keep the separate mounts and limits of five; enqueue each workload in batches of five.
options.rationale: Each pool can execute its batch independently. Batching within each workload does not enforce a shared limit between pools.
